messages:
sarah-chen (sales): Quick heads up — AcmeAI is pushing to finalize a 12mo capacity agreement. They want a blended GPU mix (A100s + some cheaper options) and a clear cap on burst spend. Need deal-desk approval and a short addendum for cost splits.
omar-patel (solutions): Do we have a precedent for splitting burst charges vs committed baseline? I recall a 70/30 split in ops for a previous POC but want to confirm. @kevin-li
kevin-li (finance): We typically roll committed baseline into the ARR and treat burst as overage on a monthly invoice. For carveouts we can propose a capped burst rate with a higher per-hour price after the cap. Need ARR target and expected steady-state utilization % to model margin.
jin-wu (eng-runtime): Technical constraint: autoscaling hysteresis + pre-warm for burst has cost. If they want guaranteed sub-100ms p99 on bursts, we need reserved pool + fast-scaling margin. That should be reflected in pricing (warm-ramp hours).
sarah-chen (sales): They told us expected baseline 150 concurrent slots (A100-equivalent), burst to 450 for 2-6 hours/day during peak training windows. Ramp over 3 months.
omar-patel (solutions): Suggestion: offer a 3-tier commit: baseline reserved (committed rate), elastic buffer (discounted, limited hours/month), and on-demand burst (premium hour rate). Keeps predictability and covers warm-ramp.
kevin-li (finance): Can we model numbers quickly? If baseline commit = $X/hr for 150 slots, buffer = additional 150 slots at 40% discount up to 200 hours/mo, burst on-demand = list rate. I can run a pro-forma if we agree on X.
jin-wu (eng-runtime): Also flag for deal doc: mixed GPU fleet means potential 10-18% perf variance. Recommend we define "A100-equivalent" in the SOW with latency SLOs and a fallback variant.
sarah-chen (sales): @deploy-bot can you attach the standard commit addendum + our previous mixed-fleet clause? Need to send a draft to Acme by EOD tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Attached: commit-addendum-template-v2.pdf, mixed-fleet-clause-snippet.txt
omar-patel (solutions): I'll draft a short commercial appendix with the three-tier pricing and warm-ramp hours called out. Keep the buffer hours non-transferable to prevent abuse.
kevin-li (finance): Also request a prepayment discount option (quarterly or annual). If they prepay 6mo+ we can give 5-7% off baseline. Add an approval line for >10% discounts to deal desk.
sarah-chen (sales): For approvals: I need a quick thumbs-up from finance + eng on SLO wording. Legal will want termination / usage reconciliation language.
jin-wu (eng-runtime): Thumbs up on SLO wording I suggested; include a clause: "If observed 95th p99 latency exceeds SLO across three non-consecutive business days, we will trigger fallback model or capacity reallocation." Keep metrics narrow.
kevin-li (finance): I can sign off on the pricing structure once Omar posts the pro-forma numbers. After that, route to deal-desk with the following tags: discount >7% OR nonstandard termination -> requires VP-sales sign-off.
sarah-chen (sales): OK I'm assembling the email. Omar — can you drop the appendix and a simple cost table? Example rate snippet below for the outreach: 
```
Baseline (committed): 150 slots @ $X/hr = $BASE/mo
Elastic buffer: up to 150 slots @ 40% off list, cap 200 hrs/mo
On-demand burst: list rate (applies after buffer or outside hours)
Warm-ramp compensation: 2.5 warm hours per burst hour at 50% of list to cover pre-warm capacity
Prepay discount: 6mo = 5%, 12mo = 8%
```
omar-patel (solutions): Dropping appendix now. I added sample numbers for two X values so finance can choose which sku to map to. Also added an "audit" line for usage reconciliation monthly.
kevin-li (finance): Received. Running model now — will post by 16:30 PT. If numbers look ok, please flag for deal-desk with summary + recommended concession band.
sarah-chen (sales): Thanks all. If deal-desk approves the concession band, I'll send the draft addendum and loop legal. Expect a short thread with the final sign-off request. :white_check_mark:
